objective.summary: Advance the CFML-first static linkage library/CLI/evidence provider through the smallest dependency-ready task, with deterministic bounded non-executing behavior, evidence-backed verification, synchronized documentation, and one focused local commit.
objective.completion_rule: Do not claim completion until every explicit requirement is mapped to current repository evidence and no required deliverable, gate, or environment proof remains missing.

repository_premise_check.claim: The supplied premise says that source, manifest, tests, CI, runtime, package, and release are absent.
repository_premise_check.observed: Source, a private manifest, tests, a read-only CI workflow, and bounded local package/CLI evidence are present; runtime compatibility and release evidence remain partial or absent.
repository_premise_check.remaining_gap: There is no full parser/runtime, hosted CI run, public package, tag, deployment, or release.

Milestones, epic acceptance criteria, risks, and bounded implementation state are recorded.
Dependency-aware delivery sequence, exit evidence, and unresolved release/runtime work are recorded.
Task states, dependencies, bounded evidence, and the T-037–T-039 blocker are recorded.
